practical_scenarios.title: Bot duplicates supplier payments
practical_scenarios.situation: A queue retry appears to have created the same payment twice after a network timeout.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Pause the affected process, identify transaction keys and external payment state, stop blind retries, reconcile all uncertain items, reverse duplicates through approved finance controls, then implement idempotency and a crash-safe completion pattern.

practical_scenarios.title: UI selector fails after application update
practical_scenarios.situation: An overnight desktop automation cannot find a submit button after a vendor UI release.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Disable repeated failing runs, inspect the new element tree and screenshots, identify changed attributes or readiness state, update the narrowest selector or anchor, regression-test variants and document vendor-version dependency before controlled release.

practical_scenarios.title: Credential expires during month-end
practical_scenarios.situation: A critical unattended process begins failing authentication during month-end close.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Assess backlog and deadline impact, rotate or restore the credential through the vault, validate least-privilege access in a controlled run, resume from reconciled queue state and add expiry monitoring and dual-control rotation procedures.

practical_scenarios.title: Maker sends customer data to consumer app
practical_scenarios.situation: A business user connects a customer-data flow to a personal file-sharing service.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Disable or quarantine the flow, preserve evidence, assess data exposure with privacy and security teams, revoke connections, notify required owners, then apply DLP, connector governance and maker training without assuming policy alone solves authorization.

practical_scenarios.title: Webhook provider retries every event
practical_scenarios.situation: A partner webhook retries because the workflow takes too long to return, creating duplicate downstream records.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Acknowledge validated events quickly, queue long processing, use event IDs as idempotency keys, reconcile duplicates, verify provider retry rules and monitor queue age and callback failures.

practical_scenarios.title: Automation backlog breaches SLA
practical_scenarios.situation: Transaction volume doubles and queue age grows even though bots are healthy.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Validate arrival rate and service time, prioritize critical items, add safe capacity or schedule changes, remove bottlenecks, communicate projected recovery and revise capacity thresholds based on observed peaks.

practical_scenarios.title: Low-code app shows incomplete records
practical_scenarios.situation: Users report that a canvas app search misses older records after data growth.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Reproduce with production-like volume, inspect delegation warnings and query plans, replace nondelegable formulas with supported server-side filters or views, add indexes where relevant and test authorization and result completeness.

practical_scenarios.title: RPA project has no process owner
practical_scenarios.situation: A bot is ready for release, but no business team accepts ownership of rules or exceptions.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Do not release an orphaned service. Escalate the governance gap, assign process, technical and operational owners, document rules, SLAs and exception handling, and obtain acceptance and support readiness before production.

practical_scenarios.title: API rate limit causes cascading failures
practical_scenarios.situation: A workflow receives HTTP 429 responses and retries immediately across thousands of items.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Throttle intake, honor Retry-After, implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap concurrency and attempts, preserve items in a durable queue and coordinate capacity expectations with the API owner.

practical_scenarios.title: AI extracts wrong bank account
practical_scenarios.situation: A document model is highly confident but extracts the wrong bank account from an invoice.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Stop automatic payment use, validate affected documents and downstream transactions, compare source evidence, require deterministic account validation and stronger human review for critical fields, then recalibrate thresholds and monitor field-level errors.

practical_scenarios.title: Production workflow edited directly
practical_scenarios.situation: An administrator fixes a production flow in the portal but cannot reproduce the change in test.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Capture and stabilize the production definition, assess impact, export or compare it with source, create the correction in the governed branch, test and redeploy through the pipeline, then restrict direct edits and document emergency-change handling.

practical_scenarios.title: Attended automation blocks call-center work
practical_scenarios.situation: An attended bot freezes while an agent is serving a customer and cannot release the application.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Provide a safe cancel and human takeover path, preserve the customer context, collect execution evidence, isolate timing or UI-lock issues and redesign long-running work to an asynchronous unattended process where appropriate.

practical_scenarios.title: Queue contains malformed records
practical_scenarios.situation: A new source-system release sends missing fields and the automation crashes on every item.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Pause ingestion if necessary, validate and quarantine malformed items, notify the source owner with schema evidence, keep valid work moving, version the contract and add boundary validation and compatibility tests.

practical_scenarios.title: Shared component update breaks many bots
practical_scenarios.situation: A reusable login library update causes failures across multiple automations.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Roll back or pin the prior compatible version, identify affected consumers, restore service by priority, reproduce in test and introduce semantic versioning, dependency inventory and consumer regression gates.

practical_scenarios.title: Automation savings are challenged
practical_scenarios.situation: Finance rejects a claim that a bot saved ten full-time roles because staffing did not change.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Separate time released from cashable savings, validate baseline volume and adoption, account for support and license costs, identify how capacity was redeployed and report service, risk and financial benefits under agreed rules.

practical_scenarios.title: Manual workarounds bypass automation
practical_scenarios.situation: Users export data and process it outside the new low-code app because the workflow is slower at peak time.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Observe the real workaround, quantify performance and usability issues, protect data and controls, fix capacity or design bottlenecks, involve users in testing and track adoption rather than enforcing compliance without resolving causes.

practical_scenarios.title: Webhook secret appears in logs
practical_scenarios.situation: A debugging change records an authorization header in execution history.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Restrict access and retention, rotate the exposed secret, assess where logs were exported, remove or redact the field, review similar workflows and implement structured logging rules and secret scanning.

practical_scenarios.title: Bot continues after partial failure
practical_scenarios.situation: A multi-system onboarding bot creates the user account but fails before assigning permissions and reports a generic failure.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Identify the durable state in every system, prevent duplicate account creation, complete or compensate through an approved recovery path, record the exact step and business key, and redesign with checkpoints and explicit partial-state handling.

evaluation_rubric.evidence: Frames the business problem, models current work, evaluates alternatives and selects automation only where evidence supports it.
Builds maintainable RPA, workflow or low-code solutions using reusable components, supported interfaces and sound data models.
Handles contracts, authentication, schemas, mappings, idempotency, rate limits and external system state correctly.
Designs exception paths, retries, recovery, tests, observability, queues, capacity and production support.
Applies least privilege, secret management, DLP, environment strategy, versioning, quality gates and auditability.
Uses credible benefits, ownership, adoption, training and stakeholder management rather than only technical completion.
Explains trade-offs, prioritizes user and business impact, states assumptions and proposes safe phased actions.
